title: fix(rest,runtime)!: both import doors read the walled-catalog verdict the metadata save door reads
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — under the `isolated` and `group` tenancy postures, importing a remote table as an object (`POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/external/tables/:remote/import`, and the MCP `import_object` tool) is a write to the environment's metadata catalog, and it is the platform operator's, as every other write to that catalog is.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` text teaches either import door or who may call it; the rule is stated in the docs this diff updates (`content/docs/deployment/tenancy-modes.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/odata-datasources.mdx`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：远程表导入的两道门（REST 导入路由与 MCP `import_object` 工具），在 `isolated` / `group` 租户姿态下，与元数据保存门问同一个“围墙目录写入”裁决。
- 为什么改：导入就是把一个对象存进环境共享的元数据目录；围墙姿态下这个目录只归平台运营方（与引擎自身）写，所以导入门与保存门读同一条裁决。
- 风险与回滚：围墙姿态下，平台运营方以下的调用方导入改为 `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`，什么都不读取、不保存；`single` 与未注册租户服务的部署不变；回滚即还原本 PR，已导入的对象不受影响。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/external-datasource-routes.ts`（`refuseFederationRequest` 新增的 `catalogWrite` 段）、`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`（`federationService` 新增的 `catalogWrite` 段）、`packages/qa/dogfood/test/external-import-walled-catalog-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/external-import-walled-catalog-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 6 个用例全部通过（围墙下两道门拒绝、运营方可导入、`single` 下照常导入）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The rule.** Under `isolated` and `group` every organization shares the environment's metadata catalog, and a write to it is admitted only for the platform operator and for the engine's own writes (ADR-0131 D3, D12 items 7–8, D11). An import saves an object into that catalog, so both import doors now ask the walled-catalog verdict the metadata save door asks (`walledCatalogWriteVerdict`, `@objectstack/metadata-core`) for an `object`, after the federation family's capability rule and before the federation service is looked up.
- **The answer.** A refused import answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with the verdict's sentence for an object, which is the sentence the metadata save door answers, naming the posture. Nothing is introspected and nothing is saved. A `tenancy` service that is registered and cannot answer refuses the import `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, never a permit.
- **Unchanged.** The platform operator imports under a wall as before. Under `single`, and on a deployment with no `tenancy` service, every caller holding both federation capabilities imports as before. Listing remote tables, drafting an object and validating are unchanged, and the federation capability rule answers first, as before.
- **Docs.** `deployment/tenancy-modes` lists the import among the walled writes; `data-modeling/odata-datasources` states who imports under a wall; row 55b of the system-context census names both import doors, with its register regenerated.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/external-datasource-routes-auth-guard.test.ts`: under `group` and `isolated` an administrator holding both federation capabilities is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` before the service is looked up; the sentence equals the verdict's sentence for an object; the capability rule still answers first; listing is still served; the platform operator and the `single` / no-tenancy controls import `201`; a failing `tenancy` service answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-federation-bridge.test.ts`: the same rule, refusals and controls at the MCP bridge.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/external-import-walled-catalog-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`: a booted showcase under `group` with the federation service and the MCP server mounted. An organization administrator holding both capabilities is refused at the REST door with the save door's status and sentence, and at `import_object` (a real OAuth agent token granted `metadata:write` and `actions:execute`) with the same code and sentence; nothing is saved. Controls: the platform operator imports at both doors under the same wall, and under `single` the same kind of administrator imports at both doors.

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the rule sits: at the two doors, not in the shared save path.** The save path below the doors (`saveMetaItem` behind `importObject`) receives the item and the landing it resolved, not the caller's rung or whether the caller is the engine, so judging there would mean threading the caller into the federation service contract. The doors are where caller admission already lives in this family (the capability rule runs there), so the walled verdict runs beside it and refuses before any landing is resolved or any remote schema is read.
- **The code.** The status and the sentence are the save door's. The code is `PERMISSION_DENIED`, the standard-catalog member this family already answers for a 403; the REST `/meta` door answers its grandfathered synonym (`STANDARD_SYNONYM_WAIVERS`, ADR-0112 D3), which keeps a wire value and is not endorsed for new code.
- **Breaking, patch.** An accept-set narrowing under a walled posture only; no key of any schema moves and nothing stored changes, so both packages take a patch with a BREAKING banner (ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).
